mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% MoM signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in real GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy in a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) below 1 million units signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1 million.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained RSAFS growth.
